<summary>CodeRabbit commands</summary>

CodeRabbit reviews only when asked. Comment on this PR with `@coderabbitai` followed by:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `review` | Review the commits pushed since its last review |
| `full review` | Review the whole PR from scratch |
| `resolve` | Resolve all of its review comments |
| `help` | List every command |

</details>
